title: Hair & Makeup by Gerta | Hair Stylist & Makeup Artist – Staten Island, NY
description: Gerta Lila, hair stylist and makeup artist at Le Vigne Hair Salon, Staten Island, NY. Balayage, color, cuts, keratin, Brazilian blowouts and natural makeup.

hero.welcome: I’m Gerta Lila, a hair stylist and makeup artist in Staten Island, NY. I create fresh cuts, color, extensions and soft, flattering makeup that highlight your natural beauty and last all day.

meet.paragraph_1: I offer makeup that looks natural, photographs beautifully, and lasts all day. Whether it’s a party, photoshoot, or any special event, I create the perfect look so you feel confident and beautiful throughout your special day.

notes: Redesign of 12 November 2026 (build contract, decisions 44 and 45). The page is laid out anew and its words are cut and rearranged from the live Wix text. Every change of wording is on the fixed list of intended differences in qa/check_content.py, with the date and the reason. They are these. (1) The h1 is the business name Hair & Makeup by Gerta, the site title that Wix shows above the beige box. (2) The headline "It's Your Day to Shine!" is gone, together with the beige box. (3) hero.welcome starts with I’m Gerta Lila. The first sentence of the Wix text, "Welcome to HairByGerta.com.", is cut, the other two sentences are word for word. (4) The Book Online button is gone. hero.call is the Call button (Call 347-671-5095, it calls the number) and hero.text the Text link (Text Gerta, it starts a text message to the same number). (5) The phone number no longer stands on its own line, it is part of the Call button. (6) The scrolling hours line is plain text, shown once in the hero (hero.hours) and once under Find me (find.hours), in the words of content/site.json. (7) The salon name and the address moved from the beige box to Find me, without the map pin. (8) New words that the Wix home page does not have, the headings Services and Find me, the four group names Cut and style, Color, Smoothing and texture and Occasions, the ten service names of the Book Online page, the link More about each service and the link Open in Google Maps (the same words as under the map of the Contact page).

The design brief gives the hours in its sketch as Tuesday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM. hero.hours and find.hours keep the words of content/site.json (Tuesday - Saturday, 9 AM - 5 PM), because business facts stay exactly as stored there. ASK the owner whether the hours should read Tuesday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM on every page, as the closing line of the Book Online page already does.

services.groups lists the ten services (items) of content/book-online.json in the four groups of the design brief, with the names exactly as the Book Online page writes them (Kids’ Haircut keeps its curly apostrophe). When a service is renamed, added or removed, change both files.

hero.photos are g13 and g12, the owner's own photos and the only photos of the site that are licensed for use outside Wix. Their alt texts are the ones of the Gallery page, word for word. width and height of a photo slot are the size its img element states, which gives the shape of the frame (9 to 16). The stylesheet decides how big it is shown.

photo_row (four photos) and the two Meet Gerta photos (meet.portrait, meet.large) are placeholders today, so alt is empty and the page leaves them out (decision 44). When the owner puts in one of these photos with tools/add_photo.py, it appears by itself, the photo row under Services and the Meet Gerta photos under her text. alt_original of home-styling, foils-highlights and makeup-red-lips is the alt text of the live Wix image, copied exactly. For foils-highlights that is only a file name (the first version described the photo as Stylist finishing a blowout in the salon). For makeup-red-lips it includes the leading space, the double spaces and the cut-off ending that Wix has. alt_original of home-smile, home-waves and meet-extensions comes from the first version, because the live Wix images have an empty alt. For meet-extensions one word was changed (Gerta became Stylist), because it is one of the 26 Wix-only stock or template photos and no source says that the person in it is Gerta.
Typo fixed on 9 November 2026. The comma in high-quality, hair extensions (meet.paragraph_2) was taken out, it now reads high-quality hair extensions. On the fixed list of intended differences.

title is the live Wix title tag, unchanged (it keeps its en dash). description was rewritten on 9 November 2026, because the Wix text read badly ("is a hair stylist Staten Island NY and makeup artist"). The Wix text was Hair & Makeup by Gerta is a hair stylist Staten Island NY and makeup artist specializing in balayage highlights, color, cuts, keratin treatments, Brazilian blowouts and soft, natural glam for every occasion. The new text names Gerta, the salon and the town, and fits in the 160 characters a search result shows. On the fixed list of intended differences.
meet.heading is stored as Wix has it (Meet Gerta, a name, so its capitals stay). Apostrophes are kept as on the live site, curly in I’m and it’s.
